score_note: A warm, simple classic analogue polysynth with a big factory library.
description: u-he's free virtual analogue synthesizer, first made with the German magazine Amazona: two oscillators, noise and a ring modulator, a mixer with overdrive and filter feedback, a twin filter related to an early Diva, loopable analogue-style envelopes, two LFOs and a small modulation matrix, with over 580 factory presets. The 2025 beta adds CLAP. Free, closed source.
name: Tyrell N6

linux-x86_64.post_install_notes: Its presets and skins go to ~/.u-he/TyrellN6, where it also keeps your own presets; Uninstall removes that folder too. u-he calls its Linux builds beta.
